name: Unabated Ticket
description: Click a price on the Unabated odds screen; see the bet and its Kelly stake in a side panel. An Edges tab lists every positive-edge line (main and, optionally, alternate spreads/totals) across every team sport Unabated prices, plus the live screen's between-quarters NFL edges read off the open Unabated tab, with Chrome notifications for new ones. A Bets tab and per-line flags show which lines and games you already have a bet on, read from a local bets service (Kalshi, Novig, BetOnline, BFA, Wagerzon, Polymarket US) and from your own Bet105 login in this Chrome; the service also keeps the team crosswalk the panel learns from bets the board joins by venue id. A Teasers tab builds the set of Buckeye 6-point 4-team teasers to bet, priced off Unabated's fair and sized with Kelly over the whole set under Buckeye's $200 limit, around the teasers already open at BFA.
